title: USA Crits Expands to Virginia, Brings Back a Seven Race Series for 2027
content:
The series adds Newport News Twilight to its lineup of criteriums around the American Southeast in a seven-race, three-week block.

Read the full article at USA Crits Expands to Virginia, Brings Back a Seven Race Series for 2027 on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
